task.title: Open existing event-log state read-only
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/815 with an explicit fail-closed read-only event-log boundary reusable by typed schedule projections.
acceptance_criteria: Open only an existing SQLite event log with read-only/no-create flags and query-only defense in depth.
Validate WAL mode and the expected events-table contract without changing pragmas or schema.
Expose ScheduleStore projections through the same boundary while mutation attempts append no event.
Document filesystem and SQLite sidecar limitations without claiming snapshot, secrecy, or immutable-media guarantees.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests failed because EventLog::open_read_only and ScheduleStore::open_read_only did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added missing-file non-creation, existing WAL projection, mutation rejection, schema absence, incompatible mode, and reopen tests.

attempts.summary: Implemented a validated no-create observation boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: Existing constructors requested write settings and initialized schema, so observation itself required mutation authority.
attempts.patch: Opened SQLite with read-only flags, enabled query_only, validated journal mode and required event columns, and reused the event log from ScheduleStore.

attempts.summary: Addressed both substantive hosted review findings.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found that incompatible schemas lacked operator diagnostics and that documentation omitted WAL/SHM sidecar prerequisites and the lack of immutable=1 support.
attempts.patch: Added distinct missing-table and column-mismatch reasons with RED-to-GREEN coverage, then documented sidecar and immutable-media limitations in one follow-up commit.

outcome.summary: Typed callers can inspect existing durable scheduler state without schema initialization or event mutation, while incompatible storage fails closed with useful diagnostics.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test event_log
nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test schedule_store

lessons: Observation needs an explicit storage boundary; reusing a write constructor with good intentions still grants creation and mutation authority.
Read-only mode should validate the schema it depends on rather than silently initialize or accept an incompatible database.
SQLite read-only access may still depend on WAL and SHM sidecars, so filesystem read-only media requires a different explicit contract.
Review diagnostics should distinguish a missing table from incompatible required columns while preserving fail-closed behavior.
A false-green rate-limited review status is not substantive review evidence and must not race auto-merge.
